source: OSRS Wiki: Orange dye, Red dye, Yellow dye (Aggie in Draynor Village); Ecto-token, Ectofuntus; Chocolatey milk, Hangover cure, Seasoned sardine.
note: Items that are made from other items. If the made item is missing, the ingredients are planned too, so the player is warned before leaving the place where they are made.

from.how: Aggie in Draynor Village makes it: 3 redberries + 5 gp.
Aggie in Draynor Village makes it: 2 onions + 5 gp.

Ecto-token.note: 5 tokens a worship (OSRS Wiki, Ecto-token). The 60 seconds a worship are an estimate: grinding the bone, filling the bucket in the basement and worshipping.

from.how: Any bones: crushed into bonemeal in the pot at the bone grinder upstairs in the Ectofuntus.
Holds the bonemeal from the bone grinder.
Filled with slime at the pool in the Ectofuntus basement.

Chocolatey milk.note: Use chocolate dust on a bucket of milk (OSRS Wiki, Chocolatey milk). The 2 seconds are an estimate of one use action.

from.how: Milk a dairy cow with a bucket, or buy one.
Grind a chocolate bar with a knife or a pestle and mortar, or buy it.

Hangover cure.note: Use snape grass on chocolatey milk (OSRS Wiki, Hangover cure). The 2 seconds are an estimate of one use action.

from.how: Use chocolate dust on a bucket of milk.
Spawns west of the Crafting Guild, or buy it.

Seasoned sardine.note: Use doogle leaves on a raw sardine (OSRS Wiki, Seasoned sardine). The 2 seconds are an estimate of one use action.

from.how: Buy it, or fish one with a fishing rod and bait.
Spawns behind Gertrude's house west of Varrock.

Bucket of slime.note: Use a bucket on the slime pool in the Ectofuntus basement (OSRS Wiki, Bucket of slime). The 30 seconds are an estimate of the climb down and back.

from.how: Buy one at a general store.

Nettle tea.note: Use nettles on a bowl of water, then cook the nettle-water (OSRS Wiki, Nettle tea). The 30 seconds are an estimate.

from.how: Fill a bowl at a sink or fountain.
Pick them wearing gloves, for example north of Draynor Manor.
